problem: Source 'a good deal of the organ of Adhesiveness' is a phrenology allusion (Rochester's half-mocking pseudo-scientific diagnosis); MODERN 'your strong capacity for attachment' drops the allusion and its teasing register.
new_text: "You must have grown somewhat attached to the house—you, with your eye for natural beauty and a good deal of what the phrenologists call the organ of Adhesiveness?"

problem: Source keeps Rochester's reply as reported speech inside quotes: '"It might pass for the present," he said; "but he would yet see me glittering like a parterre."' MODERN mixes direct present ('It will do for the present') with reported third person ('but he would yet see me'), so the sentence reads as a speaker switch mid-quote.
new_text: The hour spent at Millcote was somewhat trying for me. Mr. Rochester made me go to a certain silk warehouse, where I was ordered to choose half a dozen dresses. I hated the business and begged to put it off — but no, it had to be done now. By means of urgent whispers, I reduced the half dozen to two. These, however, he vowed he would select himself. With anxiety I watched his eye roam over the colourful displays. He settled on a rich silk of the most brilliant amethyst and a superb pink satin. I told him in a fresh series of whispers that he might as well buy me a gold gown and a silver bonnet at once — I would certainly never dare to wear his choices. With enormous difficulty, for he was stubborn as a stone, I persuaded him to exchange them for a sober black satin and a pearl-grey silk. "It might do for the present," he said, "but he would yet see me glittering like a flower garden."

problem: Source 'three-tailed bashaw as you are' (an Ottoman pasha of highest rank, continuing the seraglio/Stamboul imagery of 24.128-24.130) is flattened to the generic 'mighty overlord that you are', losing the specific Eastern image Jane is turning back on him.
new_text: "I'll be preparing myself to go out as a missionary to preach liberty to the enslaved — your harem prisoners among the rest. I'll get admitted there, and I'll start a mutiny. And you, three-tailed pasha that you are, sir, shall in no time find yourself chained in our hands. Nor will I, for one, agree to cut your bonds until you have signed a charter — the most generous that any tyrant ever granted."

problem: Source ends 'not be hurried away in a suttee.' The repair appends an explanatory gloss 'like a widow burned on her husband's pyre', adding a widow image and explanation absent from Jane's clipped retort (and slightly odd, since Jane is not a widow). A lighter touch keeps the needed hint of meaning without the added simile.
new_text: "Indeed it was. I had as good a right to die when my time came as he did. But I should wait for that time and not be hurried away to die in a suttee."
